architecture.mechanism: The fraction of ejected heat during thermal runaway is significantly influenced by state of charge (SOC) and cell mass loss, with higher non-ejected heat at 75% SOC compared to 100% SOC due to higher fraction of ejected heat at high SOC.
architecture.intervention: Implement a battery management system that actively maintains cells at 75% state of charge to minimize non-ejected heat during thermal runaway events.
architecture.expected_effect: Reduced thermal propagation speed by minimizing the heat transferred between cells during thermal runaway events, slowing the cell-to-cell propagation from 90 seconds to a longer timeframe.
architecture.falsification_test: Conduct comparative thermal runaway tests on modules with cells maintained at 75% SOC versus 100% SOC, measuring propagation speed and temperature profiles during identical failure conditions.
